column1: # Date imputation for the 27 of 121 NCBI records that have no Isolate
# Collection date. Curated mapping, not a blind transform (coordinator
# decision 2026-10-02). Every imputed record gets date_imputed=true; records
# with a real NCBI date never appear in this file (their date_imputed field
# stays empty, matching NCBI's boolean convention: true when present, empty
#   1. Isolate-level year from Camp et al. 2021 (Parasit Vectors 14:544,
#      PMC8556901) Supplementary Table S5, accession-level mapping via
#      This resolves the 19 GQ3868xx M segments to per-isolate years
#      1958-1968 - they are NOT one 2009 study year; the study that
#      sequenced them is 2009, the mosquito isolates are 1958-1968.
#   2. Strain-name year suffix, verified in the literature:
#        a sick child, Czechoslovakia (Ruzek et al. 2020, Microbiol Res
#        Announc 9: e00961-20, PMID 33020166; complete genomes EU277663-665 -
#        which are NOT part of this record set).
#      - prototype "92" Bardos: isolated 1958, Aedes caspius, former
#        EU185046.1 "Bardos 92-like" (963 nt L fragment) is imputed to the
#        prototype year too; lower confidence - a "92-like" field isolate
#        would have its own (unknown) isolation year.
#   3. Release-date year, last resort: AX230490.1 (294 nt patent fragment,
#      no isolate lineage, no geo, no collection date; released 2001).
# Release-year would be decades off for every old record (released 1996-2011),
# so it was used only where no better signal exists (AX230490.1).
# Format: 3 columns, no header - <accession> <field> <value> - consumed by
# inline trailing '#' comments are ignored by augur. Edit rows here to revise.
